loss: three-class cross entropy; mean within case then across training cases; no class weighting; L2 same original coefficient
architecture: V2 width16, two self layers, two relation bases; only output dimensions changed. S 14 shared zero-initialized 3-class logits; B18-feature no-bias linear head
graph: reuse unchanged pilot graph files, no annotation or semantic edits
standardization: training groups only; no held labels or all-case class priors
split: leave-one-case-group-out; existing distinct group IDs, broader links unconfirmed; exposed development not sealed test
answer_case_basis: preselected material types: multi-level possession dispute, statutory institution changes, contested first-instance facts
final_task: unchanged pack.prompt and V21 examples/output contract; no proposal, scores, use labels or references to preferred law IDs

final_model.visible_family: Latest expected; verify each new conversation

share: same case and byte-identical complete prompt only
review: one concentrated local source review after all final answers; no new review model calls
stop: after80fits, <=12unique final answers and one source review; no tuning or follow-on round
